ns2:section.sectionText: Surfaces, Interfaces and Colloidal Science, Pre-req: CEE 442, 443, 444, or consent of instructor. The goal of the course is to provide a sound basis of the fundamental and advanced principles of interfacial and colloid phenomena. The course will deal with surface adsorption of organic molecules, interacting forces between colloidal particles and organic molecules in the aquatic environment, as well as functionalization of the solid-liquid interface to ?tailor? adsorption and surface interactions. Surface Biology will be addressed as well. Besides the theoretical background, the students will be provided with knowledge about the state-of-the-art experimental tools in surface and colloidal science. The applications are directly related to Environmental Engineering and Science to help students to identify the connections between surface science, other courses in their program and their own research.
